name: io.github.Servosity/salesbuildr-mcp
title: Salesbuildr MCP
description: Every Salesbuildr resource as a scriptable command, plus offline margin and pipeline analytics.

environmentVariables.name: SALESBUILDR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the SALESBUILDR_API_KEY credential for the Salesbuildr MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: SALESBUILDR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from SALESBUILDR_TENANT. Set it only to point at a different host.

environmentVariables.name: SALESBUILDR_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: Your Salesbuildr tenant subdomain (the {tenant} in https://{tenant}.salesbuildr.com).

environmentVariables.name: SALESBUILDR_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write to Salesbuildr: only read tools are callable. Leave blank to allow writes (each MCP write still previews first and sends only when called again with confirm set to true).

environmentVariables.name: SALESBUILDR_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: SALESBUILDR_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Salesbuildr requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: SALESBUILDR_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
